Keep the camera fixed; preserve robot geometry, physically valid joint motion, and normal gripper opening and closing.
observed_terminal_state: The potato has been released downward inside the lower white tray. The right hand is open above it and the left hand remains raised open. The fingers partly occlude the final potato/tray contact; later settling and hand withdrawal are not visible.

arm_hand_roles.right: Active throughout the manipulation: grasps the potato, lifts and transports it, lowers it inside the lower tray, and opens to release.
arm_hand_roles.left: Remains raised open beside the table; does not grasp, support, transfer, or contact the potato or shelf.
arm_hand_roles.coordination: Single-hand manipulation. No hand-to-hand transfer or assisting contact; the visible person does not participate.

uncertainties: The open right thumb partly occludes the final potato/tray contact; the exact resting orientation and later settling after release are not visible.

data_quality_gate.rule: Variance of the Laplacian of the luma of the model-view frame (cover-resize to the nearest-aspect 720p-class bucket, center crop); pass if >= 120 third-person, >= 60 first-person.
